title: Fitness Foundation for Beginners
description: A balanced fitness plan for beginners focusing on building healthy habits and consistency

goals.title: Build Consistent Exercise Habit
goals.description: Exercise at least 4 times per week for 30 minutes

goals.title: Improve Cardiovascular Health
goals.description: Complete 20 minutes of cardio 3 times per week

goals.title: Build Basic Strength
goals.description: Complete bodyweight exercises 2 times per week

habits.title: Morning Stretch
habits.description: 10 minutes of light stretching every morning

habits.title: Drink Water
habits.description: Drink 8 glasses of water throughout the day

tasks.title: Create Workout Schedule
tasks.description: Plan your weekly workout days and times

tasks.title: Research Basic Exercises
tasks.description: Learn proper form for push-ups, squats, and planks

tasks.title: Buy Workout Clothes
tasks.description: Get comfortable clothes and shoes for exercising

tasks.title: Find Workout Space
tasks.description: Identify where you'll exercise (home, gym, park)

warnings: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
Listen to your body and rest when needed
Consult a doctor before starting any new exercise program
fallback_message: I found a great fitness template for beginners! Let me set you up with a balanced plan to build healthy exercise habits.
